en.name: Sunflower oil
en.summary: Sunflower oil keeps 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight. Ordinary sunflower oil is dominated by linoleic acid, a polyunsaturated fat, which makes it one of the less stable everyday oils; the high-oleic version sold for deep frying is a different fat altogether. Either way it fails by oxidising rather than by spoiling in any microbial sense.
en.pantry: 1 year from purchase, cool, dark, tightly capped. Standard sunflower oil runs heavily to polyunsaturated fat, and polyunsaturated fat is exactly what oxygen attacks — refining takes out the compounds that would otherwise go first, but it cannot change the fatty acids. High-oleic sunflower oil, sold specifically for frying, is mostly monounsaturated and handles heat far better, though it still ages on the shelf. There is a tell unique to this oil: linoleic acid polymerises as it oxidises, so an old bottle develops a sticky, varnish-like film around the neck and under the cap that will not simply wash off. That tacky ring means the bottle has been open a long time and what is inside has aged to match. The cupboard directly above the hob is the worst place in the house for it.
en.fridge: No refrigerated figure is published for sunflower oil, and a bottle in regular use does not need one. Chilling does slow the oxidation, so it is a defensible plan for a very large bottle through a hot summer; the oil turns cloudy and viscous, which is harmless and reverses at room temperature. In truth, though, buying the size you will finish in a couple of months does more for quality than refrigerating the size you will not.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published, and freezing sunflower oil achieves nothing. Oil thickens in the cold rather than setting, so a frozen bottle is just a bottle that will not pour, and every trip out of the freezer leaves condensation on the glass and eventually inside it. That is the one route by which a bottle of oil genuinely spoils rather than merely ages: neat oil gives microbes nothing to work with, and a layer of water at the bottom does.
en.thawing: Leave a chilled bottle at room temperature until it runs clear and pours normally again. Resist standing it in hot water or next to a warm oven — warming an oil to save ten minutes takes days off the far end of its life.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid oil, and decisive.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
A sticky, varnish-like film around the neck and cap.
Colour noticeably darker than when the bottle was opened.
tips: Buy a bottle you will finish within a few months of opening.
Never store oil above the hob.
Use high-oleic sunflower oil if you fry regularly; it takes heat far better.
Keep used frying oil in a separate jar — never pour it back into the fresh bottle.

faq.q: How long does sunflower oil last?
faq.a: 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight.

faq.q: Is sunflower oil good for deep-frying?
faq.a: Ordinary sunflower oil is high in polyunsaturated fat and breaks down relatively quickly under heat. High-oleic sunflower oil is mostly monounsaturated and is much better suited to frying.

faq.q: How can you tell if sunflower oil has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A crayon or paint-like note means it is rancid, and it will taste bitter and scratchy. That is a quality failure, not a pathogen risk.

zh.name: 葵花油
zh.summary: 葵花油自購買日起，放陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊，可放 1 年。一般葵花油以亞麻油酸這種多元不飽和脂肪為主，因此是日常食用油裡比較不穩定的一種；專供油炸的高油酸葵花油則是完全不同的脂肪組成。不論哪一種，它壞掉的方式都是氧化，而不是微生物意義上的腐敗。
zh.pantry: 自購買日起 1 年，陰涼、避光、鎖緊瓶蓋。標準葵花油大量偏向多元不飽和脂肪，而多元不飽和正是氧氣攻擊的對象——精煉可以去掉那些最先劣化的成分，卻改變不了脂肪酸本身。專門賣給油炸用的高油酸葵花油以單元不飽和為主，耐熱得多，但擺在架上一樣會老。這瓶油有一個獨有的線索：亞麻油酸氧化時會聚合，所以放久的葵花油瓶口和瓶蓋內側會出現一圈黏黏的、像清漆一樣的薄膜，怎麼洗都洗不太掉。那圈黏膜代表這瓶已經開了很久，裡面的油也老了相同的時間。爐台正上方的櫃子，是家裡最不該放它的地方。
zh.fridge: 葵花油沒有公布的冷藏期限，而一瓶常在用的油也不需要。冷藏確實能拖慢氧化，所以一瓶很大的油要撐過炎熱的夏天，放冷藏說得過去——油會變濁變稠，那是無害的，回到室溫就恢復。但老實說，買一瓶兩個月內用得完的容量，對品質的幫助遠大於把用不完的那瓶冰起來。
zh.freezer: 沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍葵花油一點用都沒有。油在低溫下只會變稠而不會凝固，所以凍過的瓶子就只是一瓶倒不出來的油；而每一次從冷凍庫拿出來，瓶身都會結露，水最後會跑進瓶內。那才是一瓶油真正會腐敗、而不只是變老的唯一途徑：純油不給微生物任何東西，瓶底的一層水卻給了。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放室溫，等它恢復清澈、倒得順暢再用。不要泡熱水或擺在溫熱的烤箱旁邊——為了省十分鐘去加溫一瓶油，換來的是後段少掉好幾天。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——油耗了，而且是決定性的。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
瓶頸和瓶蓋周圍出現黏黏、像亮光漆的膜。
顏色比剛開瓶時明顯變深。
tips: 買開封後幾個月內用得完的容量。
絕對不要把油放在爐台上方。
常油炸的話請用高油酸葵花油，它耐熱得多。
用過的炸油另外裝罐——絕對不要倒回新油瓶。

faq.a: 自購買日起，陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊，1 年。
一般葵花油多元不飽和脂肪高，受熱分解得比較快。高油酸葵花油以單元不飽和為主，比較適合油炸。
聞一下。像蠟筆或油漆的味道就是油耗，吃起來會苦、會刮喉嚨。那是品質問題，不是病原菌風險。
